newestFirst.content: Root cause found: the tab URL's ?s= param re-asserts after the nav guard runs, so the stale param wins and moves the view. The fix is to gate the re-assert on a user-initiated source and drop the param echo on machine navs — about 30 lines in viewNav.ts plus a regression test. Nothing is changed yet.
